description: For every nonempty first-order structure \(A\) and every ultrafilter \(\mathcal U\) on \(I\), the diagonal map \(a\mapsto[i\mapsto a]\) is an elementary embedding \(A\to A^I/\mathcal U\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Ultraproducts.diagonal.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {I : Type w} {A : Type w'}
  [L.Structure A] [Nonempty A] (U : Ultrafilter I) : L.ElementaryEmbedding A ((↑U).Product fun x => A)
